claims.explanation: Pevonedistat inhibits NAE, causing CRL inactivation and accumulation of substrates like CDT1, p27, and NRF2. Selectivity may arise from high neddylation pathway activity or dependence on CRL-mediated degradation of pro-survival factors. TP53 mutation is common in sensitive lines, but its role is unclear; other features like KEAP1/NFE2L2 mutations may sensitize by disrupting NRF2 regulation.
